messages:
Amy (Sales): quick sync — AcmeCorp wants a 2-week on-prem POC in a sealed datacenter. They listed requirements: offline bundle + signed manifest, clear rollback path, cert rotation plan, explicit upgrade cadence, and a one-off packaging price. any immediate blockers?
Devon (Solutions Eng): we can produce a minibundle (quantized model + slim runtime). need to confirm allowed libc/driver versions inside sealed DC. signing: do they accept cosign signatures or require our key escrow? @Maria?
Maria (Security): cosign preferred. if customer wants us to host signing keys we need AAR + POA from legal. also need explicit telemetry opt-out and confirmation default is telemetry-disabled in sealed builds.
Ron (SRE): ops note — transfer bandwidth is the main constraint. example size: weights ~12GB, runtime ~1.2GB. suggest delta updates for hotfixes not full rebundles. rollback supported via operator version pin + forced revert flag.
Amy (Sales): customer asked about upgrade cadence — they prefer monthly security patches, quarterly features. how does that change pricing?
Devon (Solutions Eng): packaging premium: one-time engineering + QA for sealed bundle, then per-delta update charge. rough estimate: initial package + testing = $8k-$14k, per-delta ~ $1k-$2k. will get formal quote.
Kai (Customer Eng): they want an emergency hotfix path (72h) for critical CVEs. need an ops playbook for sealed env hotfix delivery.
Maria (Security): 72h emergency feasible if pre-agree emergency signing workflow and provide signed delta manifest + acceptance tests. we need documented rollback criteria and test vectors.
Devon (Solutions Eng): sample manifest we would include in bundle:
```json
{
  "bundle_version": "2026-03-11-1",
  "components": ["model.bin","runtime.tar.gz","libs.tar.gz"],
  "signatures": {"cosign": "<sig>"}
}
```
Ron (SRE): CI trace — building sealed bundle through deploy-bot job. job: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/789 :gear:
deploy-bot: build started for bundle 2026-03-11-1 — artifacts to GCS staging (sha256 manifest attached).
Amy (Sales): next steps: 1) Devon to list exact OS/libc/driver constraints customer must accept; 2) Maria to draft AAR checklist + telemetry opt-out wording; 3) Ron to draft transfer bandwidth & rollback playbook and emergency hotfix SLA language. I'll share with customer and loop back on pricing.
Devon (Solutions Eng): will share file constraints + sample manifest by EOD.
Maria (Security): will share AAR template and telemetry checklist by EOD.
Ron (SRE): will draft playbook + transfer checklist tomorrow AM.
Amy (Sales): thanks team :thumbsup: — I'll post this as the POC action list to the SOW thread after call.
notes: POC coordination for sealed datacenter: packaging, signing, upgrade cadence, emergency hotfixes, pricing
